A5_S4_D4: ^Narrator: Being on Thavmia has really made you feel small.

^Narrator: Not in a powerless or insignificant way — but in the sense of realising where you might stand in terms of the island and its inhabitants. As a part of a wider world, which you’ve only just discovered five days ago.
^Narrator: …It’s not so bad, to be honest. There’s a bunch of people of the same size as you.
^Narrator: And smaller, too, like the cotton critter you saved…
^Noelle: (The Great Disaster really must be a huge size, to cause floods all over the Earth.)
^Narrator: Amelia notices you a little lost in thought.
^Amelia: Hey! Noelle, what's with that look? Do you need more supplies from Rowan after all?
^Amelia: So why are you so unhappy?
^Noelle: I’m just thinking about Noah’s story.
^Narrator: Amelia squints at you, realising it’s not sadness, but rather—
^Amelia: Oh, don’t tell me you want to do something crazy!
^Noelle: I’m not going to go and find the Great Disaster or anything!
^Noelle: …It’d be impossible to build a boat for that, in a month’s time.
^Noelle: (But… there’s a feeling in my gut that suggests there’s more to all of this.)
choicehope: ^Noelle: Don’t you think that with the Great Disaster’s size, it could affect more than just the floods?
^Noelle: Even a small breeze can cause stirring in the sea. If it wanted to, surely it could start a storm somewhere that’s normally free from bad weather.
^Noelle: (I’m not saying that the Great Disaster is a villain, but wouldn’t it make sense if it was aiming for Thavmia somehow, as it’s where Noah set up his base?)
^Noelle: (If I was wronged, or perhaps disrespected and angry, I might resort to such actions, too. Knocking on their door.)
^Amelia: Noelle… Even if that were true, and it’s the one causing the storms — you don’t have proof.
^Amelia: And unless the Elders have a magical way to speak to the Kraken that we don’t know about, there’s no way to confirm or appease it either.
^Noelle: …I know. But I can’t put off the feeling that there’s another clue somewhere that just hasn’t been found. Like the box I managed to open for Cillian.
^Narrator: Amelia studies your expression once more.
^Amelia: This is important to you, isn’t it?
^Amelia: Is it because you think Noah might be your ancestor?
^Narrator: A beat passes. You give Amelia a small smile.
^Noelle: I guess… I’d feel like I’ve fulfilled my purpose, if that is the case.
^Noelle: That I washed up here for a reason.
^Noelle: (That I was chased out of home, and fled, for a reason.)
^Amelia: Let’s go back to Rowan’s house and demand for fabric again. And ask Cillian if he’s got any more info before heading to the northern beach.
^Amelia: I’ve heard that the Ichthyos are familiar with seaside caves. Noah probably used them at some point.
^Amelia: But if this search comes up empty, you better be ready to rake up merit points with the settlements!
^Amelia: We are not waiting out the floods outside of the mountains!
